#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""AU compare harness modes and render timing (factory presets vs matrix diagnostic)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Literal

CompareMode = Literal["preset", "matrix"]

QUICK_ENV_KEYS = (
    "AU_COMPARE_QUICK",
    "MIAMI_COMPARE_QUICK",
    "CHICAGO_AU_COMPARE_QUICK",
)
FULL_ENV_KEYS = ("AU_COMPARE_FULL",)
MODE_ENV = "AU_COMPARE_MODE"
BPM_ENV = "AU_COMPARE_BPM"
DEFAULT_COMPARE_BPM = 170.0

MIAMI_MATRIX_CONFIGS = (
    "carrier_filter",
    "carrier_open",
    "square_open",
    "sub_open",
    "mod_triangle",
    "mod_pulse",
    "mix_depth",
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CompareTiming:
    frames: int
    note_on_frame: int
    note_off_frame: int
    steady_start: int
    steady_end: int
    label: str


FULL_TIMING = CompareTiming(
    frames=48000,
    note_on_frame=4800,
    note_off_frame=24000,
    steady_start=4800,
    steady_end=19200,
    label="full",
)

# Quick must keep the steady window entirely while the note is gated — same
# invariant as FULL (steady inside note_on..note_off). The old quick cut
# note_off at 12000 while steady ran to 19200, so env/corr/spectrum scored
# release+silence vs AU held notes and collapsed F_agg.
QUICK_TIMING = CompareTiming(
    frames=19200,
    note_on_frame=2400,
    note_off_frame=18000,
    steady_start=4800,
    steady_end=14400,
    label="quick",
)


def _truthy(val: str) -> bool:
    return val.strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")


def compare_mode() -> CompareMode:
    raw = os.environ.get(MODE_ENV, "preset").strip().lower()
    if raw in ("matrix", "diagnostic", "isolated"):
        return "matrix"
    return "preset"


def compare_full_length() -> bool:
    for key in FULL_ENV_KEYS:
        if _truthy(os.environ.get(key, "")):
            return True
    return False


def compare_quick_enabled() -> bool:
    if compare_full_length():
        return False
    for key in QUICK_ENV_KEYS:
        if _truthy(os.environ.get(key, "")):
            return True
    return False


def active_timing() -> CompareTiming:
    return QUICK_TIMING if compare_quick_enabled() else FULL_TIMING


def compare_bpm() -> float:
    raw = os.environ.get(BPM_ENV, "").strip()
    if raw:
        return float(raw)
    return DEFAULT_COMPARE_BPM


def apply_timing_to_scenario(scen: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return a copy of a Chicago/Miami preset manifest with active render length."""
    out = copy.deepcopy(scen)
    t = active_timing()
    out["frames"] = t.frames
    out["noteOnFrame"] = t.note_on_frame
    out["noteOffFrame"] = t.note_off_frame
    out["steadyWindowStart"] = t.steady_start
    out["steadyWindowEnd"] = t.steady_end
    out["compareTiming"] = t.label
    out["bpm"] = compare_bpm()
    return out


def miami_matrix_frame_count() -> int:
    return active_timing().frames


def miami_matrix_note_off_frame() -> int:
    return active_timing().note_off_frame


def steady_window_from_manifest(scen: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    start = int(scen.get("steadyWindowStart", FULL_TIMING.steady_start))
    end = int(scen.get("steadyWindowEnd", FULL_TIMING.steady_end))
    return start, end


def harness_summary_line() -> str:
    mode = compare_mode()
    timing = active_timing().label
    if mode == "preset":
        role = "primary sign-off (factory preset patches, all presets)"
    else:
        role = "secondary diagnostic (Miami per-control matrix configs only)"
    return f"mode={mode} timing={timing} ({role})"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Require production integration assertions to reject broken routing/toggles."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import sys
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
source = (root / 'firmware/src/app/smc_mixer.c').read_text()
mutants = {
    'pause-unbound': ('if (!mmc && note == 0x5Du) {', 'if (0) {'),
    'pause-no-release': ('if (note == 0x5Du) smc_lock_button(0);', 'if (0) smc_lock_button(0);'),
    'pause-no-drop-recovery': ('            else smc.lock_down = 0;', '            else /* negative: lost Pause release stays parked */;'),
    'pause-old-stop-led': ('return smc.locked || beat;', 'return !seq.playing;'),
    'play-no-pause': ('if ((seq.playing || seq.req_start || seq.req_cont) && !seq.req_stop)', 'if (0)'),
    'fx-button-navigates': ('if (smc_fx_try(note, mmc))\n        return;', 'if (0 && smc_fx_try(note, mmc))\n        return;'),
    'lock-redirect-fader': ('if (smc.locked) return smc.lock_fader[n];', 'if (smc.locked) return smc_home_target(n);'),
    'lock-redirect-knob': ('r = smc.lock_knob[n];', 'r = NONE;'),
    'select-led-fx-only': ('if (row == 3 && ui.view == V_FX && ui.overlay == O_NONE && !smk_clip_mode_on())', 'if (row == 3)'),
}
selected = sys.argv[1:] or list(mutants)
if any(name not in mutants for name in selected):
    raise SystemExit('Unknown mutation selector: ' + ', '.join(selected))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='smc-interaction-negative-') as tmp:
    for name in selected:
        before, after = mutants[name]
        assert source.count(before) == 1, name
        path = Path(tmp) / (name + '.c')
        path.write_text(source.replace(before, after, 1))
        led = name == 'select-led-fx-only'
        runner = 'smc_select_mode_test' if led else 'smc_lock_test'
        env = dict(os.environ, SMC_UI_SOURCE_FILE=str(path), SMC_LOCK_OUT=str(Path(tmp) / name),
                   SMC_SELECT_OUT=str(Path(tmp) / name))
        result = subprocess.run(['sh', 'tests/host/' + runner + '.sh'], cwd=root, env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        (Path(tmp) / (name + '.log')).write_text(result.stdout)
        if result.returncode == 0 or ('FAIL tests/host/' + runner + '.c:') not in result.stdout:
            raise SystemExit(f'{name}: expected runtime assertion, got {result.returncode}\n{result.stdout}')
        print('PASS rejected runtime mutation:', name)

#!/bin/sh
# Production boot/engine/UI regression; both product WBL1 and Chicago-only builds.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
OUT=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
if [ ! -f build/gen/felucca_font.h ] || [ ! -f build/gen/x0x_drum_samples.h ] || \
   [ ! -f build/gen/x0x_drum_tables.h ] || [ ! -f build/gen/x0x_break_bank.h ]; then
    sh host/build_host.sh --generate-only
fi
U='firmware/src/dsp/drum909.c firmware/src/dsp/drum808.c firmware/src/dsp/x0x_param.c firmware/src/dsp/bass303.c firmware/src/dsp/breaks.c firmware/src/dsp/fxbus.c firmware/src/dsp/master.c firmware/src/seq/sequencer.c firmware/src/seq/tb3po.c firmware/src/seq/pattern.c firmware/src/seq/motion.c firmware/src/app/engine.c experiments/wobble/wobble.c'
HOST_DEFS=
if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then HOST_DEFS=-D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE; fi
for wobble in 1 0; do
    ${CC:-cc} -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -ffp-contract=off -std=c99 \
        -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter -DX0X_HOST -DX0X_WOBBLE=$wobble -DX0X_DEV_WOBBLE=$wobble \
        $HOST_DEFS -Ifirmware/src -Ifirmware/src/dsp -Ibuild/gen \
        tests/host/pro_303_entry_crash_test.c $U -lm -o "$OUT/test"
    "$OUT/test" check-defaults
    "$OUT/test"
    "$OUT/test" invalid-retained
done
